title: NODE ZERO
description: Choose an infection strain — a real graph-search algorithm — and watch it race through a neon network. Learn why smart algorithms explore less.
long_description:
Every strain in NODE ZERO is a real graph-search algorithm: RIPPLE is breadth-first search, TENDRIL is depth-first, MISER is Dijkstra's algorithm, BLOODHOUND is greedy best-first, ORACLE is A* search, and PARANOIA is Bellman-Ford.

Read the sector map, call your shot, and watch all six race at once — the leaderboard scores each strain by how much work it did, so you can see exactly why the smart ones explore less.
